sections.title: The prophet Elijah and King Ahaziah.

verses.text: አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ ሞዓብ በእስራኤል ላይ ዐመፀ።
አካዝያስም በሰማርያ በሰገነቱ ላይ ሳለ በዐይነ ርግቡ ወድቆ ታመመ፤ እርሱም፥ “ሂዱ፥ ከዚህ ደዌ እድን እንደ ሆነ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ጠይቁ” ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ እነርሱም ሊጠይቁለት ሄዱ።
የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ቴስብያዊውን ኤልያስን ጠርቶ፥ “ተነሣ፤ የሰማርያን ንጉሥ መልእክተኞች ለመገናኘት ሂድና፦ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቁ ዘንድ የምትሄዱት በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን?
ነገሩ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በላቸው” አለው። ኤልያስም ሄደ፤ እንዲሁም ነገራቸው።
መልእክተኞቹም ወደ አካዝያስ ተመለሱ፤ እርሱም፥ “ለምን ተመለሳችሁ?” አላቸው።
እነርሱም፥ “አንድ ሰው ሊገናኘን መጣና፦ ሂዱ፤ ወደ ላካችሁ ንጉሥ ተመልሳችሁ፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ የላክህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን? ስለዚህ ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም በሉት አለን” አሉት።
እርሱም፥ “ሊገናኛችሁ የወጣው፦ ይህንስ ቃል የነገራችሁ ሰው መልኩ ምን ይመስላል?” አላቸው።
እነርሱም፥ “ሰውዬው ጠጕራም ነው፤ በወገቡም ጠፍር ታጥቆ ነበር” አሉት። እርሱም፥ “ቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ ነው” አላቸው።
ንጉሡም ይጠሩት ዘንድ የአምሳ አለቃውን ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ወደ እርሱ ላከ፤ ወደ እርሱም ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ በተራራ ራስ ላይ ተቀምጦ አገኙት። የአምሳ አለቃውም፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ! ንጉሡ ይጠራሃል ፈጥነህ ና፤ ውረድ” አለው።
ኤልያስም መልሶ የአምሳ አለቃውን፥ “እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፤ አንተንም፥ አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ” አለው። እሳትም ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎች በላች።
ደግሞም ሌላ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ላከበት፤ የአምሳ አለቃውም፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ! ንጉሡ፦ ና፤ ፈጥነህ ውረድ ይላል” ብሎ ተናገረ።
ኤልያስም፥ “እኔስ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ሆንሁ እሳት ከሰማይ ትውረድ፤ አንተንም፥ አምሳውንም ሰዎችህን ትብላ” አለው። እሳትም ከሰማይ ወርዳ እርሱንና አምሳውን ሰዎች በላች።
ንጉሡም ደግሞ ሦስተኛ የአምሳ አለቃ ከአምሳ ሰዎች ጋር ላከ፤ ሦስተኛውም የአምሳ አለቃ ወጥቶ በኤልያስ ፊት በጕልበቱ ተንበረከከና ለመነው እንዲህም አለው፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ! ሰውነቴና የእነዚህ የአምሳው ባሪያዎችህ ሰውነት በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን።
እነሆ፥ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዳ የፊተኞቹን ሁለቱን የአምሳ አለቆችና አምሳ አምሳውን ሰዎቻቸውን በላች፤ አሁን ግን ነፍሴ በፊትህ የከበረች ትሁን።”
የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ኤልያስን፥ “ከእርሱ ጋር ውረድ፤ ከፊታቸውም የተነሣ አትፍራ” ብሎ ነገረው። ኤልያስም ተነሥቶ ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ንጉሡ ወረደ።
ኤልያስም፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ የአቃሮንን አምላክ ብዔልዜቡልን ትጠይቅ ዘንድ መልእክተኞችን ለምን ላክህ? በእስራኤል ዘንድ አምላክ ስለሌለ ነውን? እንደዚህ አይደለም፤ ትሞታለህ እንጂ ከወጣህበት አልጋ አትወርድም” አለው።
ኤልያስም እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል ሞተ።
አካዝያስ ያደረገው የቀረውም ነገር እነሆ፦ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል። በእርሱም ፋንታ የአክዓብ ልጅ ወንድሙ ኢዮራም ነገሠ።

sections.title: The Ascension of Elijah

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ኤልያስን በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ በሚያወጣው ጊዜ ኤልያስና ኤልሳዕ ከጌልጌላ ተነሥተው ሄዱ።
ኤልያስም ኤልሳዕን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ወደ ቤቴል ልኮኛልና በዚሁ ቈይ” አለው። ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ሕያው ነፍስህንም አልለይህም” አለው። ወደ ቤቴልም ደረሱ።
በቤቴልም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ መጥተው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከአንተ ለይቶ ዛሬ እንደሚወስደው ዐውቀሃልን?” አሉት። እርሱም፥ “አዎን፥ ዐውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ” አላቸው።
ኤልያስም ኤልሳዕን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ወደ ኢያሪኮ ልኮኛልና፥ በዚህ ቈይ” አለው። ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ሕያው ነፍስህንም አልለይህም” አለው።
ወደ ኢያሪኮም ደረሱ፤ በኢያሪኮም የነበሩ የነቢያት ልጆች ወደ ኤልሳዕ ቀርበው፥ “እግዚአብሔር ጌታህን ከራስህ ላይ ዛሬ እንዲወስደው ዐውቀሃልን?” አሉት። እርሱም፥ “አዎን፥ ዐውቄአለሁ፤ ዝም በሉ” አላቸው።
ኤልያስም ኤልሳዕን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ልኮኛልና እባክህ፥ በዚህ ቈይ” አለው። ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ሕያው ነፍስህንም አልለይህም” አለው፤ ሁለቱም ሄዱ።
ከነቢያትም ልጆች አምሳ ሰዎች ሄዱ፤ በፊታቸውም ርቀው ቆሙ፤ እነዚህም ሁለቱ በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመው ነበር።
ኤልያስም መጠምጠሚያውን ወስዶ ጠቀለለው፤ የዮርዳኖስንም ውኃ መታበት፤ ውኃውም ወዲህና ወዲያ ተከፈለ፤ ሁለቱም በደረቅ ተሻገሩ። ወጥተውም በምድረ በዳው ቆሙ።
ከተሻገሩም በኋላ ኤልያስ ኤልሳዕን፥ “ከአንተ ሳልወሰድ አደርግልህ ዘንድ የምትሻውን ለምን” አለው፤ ኤልሳዕም፥ “መንፈስህ በእኔ ላይ ሁለት እጥፍ ይሆን ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ” አለ።
ኤልያስም፥ “አስቸጋሪ ነገር ለምነሃል፤ ነገር ግን ከአንተ ዘንድ በተወሰድሁ ጊዜ ብታየኝ ይሆንልሃል፤ አለዚያ ግን አይሆንልህም” አለው።
ሁለቱም እየተነጋገሩ ሲሄዱ፥ እነሆ፥ የእሳት ሰረገላና የእሳት ፈረሶች በሁለቱ መካከል ገብተው ከፈሉአቸው፤ ኤልያስም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ንውጽውጽታ ወደ ሰማይ ወጣ።
ኤልሳዕም አይቶ፥ “አባቴ! አባቴ ሆይ! የእስራኤል ኀይላቸውና ጽንዓቸው፥” ብሎ ጮኸ። ከዚያም ወዲያ ዳግመኛ አላየውም፤ ልብሱንም ይዞ ከሁለት ቀደደው።
ኤልያስም መጠምጠሚያውን ለኤልሳዕ ጣለለት፤ በኤልሳዕም ራስ ላይ ዐረፈ። ኤልሳዕም ተመልሶ በዮርዳኖስ ዳር ቆመ።
በራሱ ላይ ያረፈችውን የኤልያስን መጠምጠሚያ ወስዶ ውኃውን መታባት፦ ውኃው ግን አልተከፈለም፤ እርሱም፥ “የኤልያስ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ወዴት ነው? እንዴትስ ነው?” አለ። ከዚህም በኋላ ውኃውን በመታ ጊዜ ወዲህና ወዲያ ተከፈለ፤ ኤልሳዕም ተሻገረ።
በኢያሪኮም የነበሩት የነቢያት ልጆች ኤልሳዕ ወደ እነርሱ ሲመጣ ባዩት ጊዜ፥ “የኤልያስ መንፈስ በኤልሳዕ ላይ ዐርፎአል” አሉ። ሊገናኙትም መጥተው በፊቱ በምድር ላይ ሰገዱለት።
እነርሱም፥ “እነሆ፥ ከአገልጋዮችህ ጋር አምሳ ኀ`ያላን ሰዎች አሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ወይም ወደ አንድ ተራራ ወይም ወደ አንድ ኮረብታ ጥሎት እንደ ሆነ፥ ሄደው ጌታህን ይፈልጉት” አሉት። ኤልሳዕም፥ “አትላኩ፤” አላቸው።
እስኪያፍራቸውም ድረስ ግድ ባሉት ጊዜ፥ “ላኩ” አለ፤ አምሳም ሰዎች ላኩ፤ ሦስት ቀንም ፈልገው አላገኙትም።
በኢያሪኮም ተቀምጦ ሳለ ወደ እርሱ ተመለሱ፤ እርሱም፥ “አትላኩ፥ አትሂዱም አላልኋችሁምን?” አላቸው።

sections.title: The wonders that Elisha performed.

verses.text: And the men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, our lord, as you can see, the city is pleasant; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”
And he said, “Bring me a new bowl, and put salt in it.” So they brought it to him.
And he went to the source of the water and cast the salt there, and said, “Thus says the Lord: I have healed this water; from now on, neither death nor barrenness shall come from it.”
So the water has been healed to this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
Then he went up from there to Bethel; and as he was going up the road, some boys came from the city and mocked him, and said, “Get out, you baldhead! Get out, you baldhead!”
And they turned around and looked at them, and in the name of the Lord, he cursed them; and two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the boys.
Then he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

sections.title: And there was a war made between the Moabites and the Israelites.

verses.text: በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በኢዮሣፍጥ በዐሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት የአክዓብ ልጅ ኢዮራም በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ ዐሥራ ሁለትም ዓመት ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን እንደ አባቱና እንደ እናቱ አልነበረም፤ አባቱም ያሠራውን የበዓልን ምስል አጠፋ።
ነገር ግን እስራኤልን ያሳታቸውን የናባጥን ልጅ የኢዮርብዓምን ኀጢአት ተከተለ፤ እርሱንም አልተወም።
የሞዓብም ንጉሥ ሞሳ ባለ በጎች ነበር፤ ለእስራኤልም ንጉሥ መቶ ሺህ የጠጕር አውራ በጎችንና መቶ ሺህ ጠቦቶችን ይገብርለት ነበር።
አክዓብም ከሞተ በኋላ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ ከዳው።
በዚያም ጊዜ ንጉሡ ኢዮራም ከሰማርያ ወጥቶ እስራኤልን ሁሉ ቈጠራቸው።
ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ “የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ከዳኝ፤ ከእኔ ጋር በሞዓብ ላይ ለሰልፍ ትሄዳለህን?” ብሎ፤ ላከ። እርሱም፥ “እወጣለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ አንተ፥ አንተም እንደ እኔ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ፥ ፈረሶቼም እንደ ፈረሶችህ ናቸው” አለ።
ደግሞም፥ “በየትኛው መንገድ እንሄዳለን?” አለ፤ እርሱም፥ “በኤዶምያስ ምድረ በዳ መንገድ” አለው።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ፥ የኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ሄዱ፤ የሰባትም ቀን መንገድ ዞሩ፤ ለሠራዊቱና ለሚጫኑ እንስሶች ውኃ አጡ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ፥ “እግዚአብሔር በሞዓብ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህን ሦስቱን ነገሥታት ጠርቶአልና ወዮ!” አለ።

And Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may inquire of the Lord by him?" And one of the kings' servants of Israel answered and said, "Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah."
And Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the Lord is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went down to him.

And Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What have I to do with thee? Get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother." And the king of Israel said unto him, "Nay; for the Lord hath called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab."
And Elisha said, "As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee."
"But now bring me a minstrel." And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.
And he said, "Thus saith the Lord: Make this valley full of ditches."
For thus saith the Lord, "Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye and your cattle and your beasts."
This is but a light thing in the sight of the Lord; he will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones."
And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
ሞዓባውያንም ሁሉ እነዚያ ነገሥታት ሊወጉአቸው እንደ መጡ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ “ሁላችሁ መሣሪያዎችን ይዛችሁ ርዱን” ብለው በሀገራቸው ሁሉ ጮኹ። ተሰበሰቡም፤ ወጥተውም በተራራው ራስ ላይ ቆሙ።
ማልደውም ተነሡ፤ ፀሐይም በውኃው ላይ አንጸባረቀ፤ ሞዓባውያንም በፊታቸው ውኃው እንደ ደም ቀልቶ አዩና፦
“ይህ የጦር ደም ነው፤ እነዚያ ነገሥታት እርስ በርሳቸው ተጋደሉ፤ ባልንጀሮቻቸውንም ገደሉ፤ አሁንም ሞዓብ ሆይ! እንግዲህ ወደ ምርኮህ ሂድ” አሉ።
ወደ እስራኤልም ሰፈር በመጡ ጊዜ እስራኤላውያን ተነሥተው ሞዓባውያንን መቱ፤ እነርሱም ከፊታቸው ሸሹ፤ ሞዓባውያንንም እየመቱ ወደ ሀገሩ ውስጥ ገቡ።
ከተሞቻቸውንም አፈረሱ፤ በመልካሞቹም እርሻዎቻቸው ሁሉ ላይ እስኪሞሉ ድረስ እያንዳንዱ ሰው አንድ አንድ ድንጋይ ይጥል ነበር፤ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ሁሉ ደፈኑ፤ የከተሞቻቸውንም ቅጥር አፈረሱ፤ የሚያምሩትን ዛፎች ሁሉ ቈረጡ፤ ባለ ወንጭፎችም ከብበው መቱአቸው።
የሞዓብም ንጉሥ እንደ ገደሉአቸውና ድል እንደነሡአቸው ባየ ጊዜ ሰይፍ የሚመዝዙ ሰባት መቶ ሰዎችን ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ፤ ወደ ኤዶምያስም ንጉሥ ያልፉ ዘንድ ሞከሩ፤ አልቻሉምም።
ከዚህ በኋላ በእርሱ ፋንታ ንጉሥ የሚሆነውን የበኵር ልጁን ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በቅጥሩ ላይ አቀረበው። እስራኤልም ታላቅ ጸጸት ተጸጸቱ፤ ከዚያም ርቀው ወደ ምድራቸው ተመለሱ።

sections.title: Elisha, the widow's son, as a helper.

verses.text: And one of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead, and you know that your servant feared the Lord; and the creditor is coming to take my two sons to be his slaves.”
And Elisha said to her, “What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?” And she said, “Your maidservant has nothing in the house except a jar of oil.”
Then he said, “Go, borrow vessels from everywhere, from all your neighbors—empty vessels; do not gather just a few.”
And when you have come in, you shall shut the door behind you and your sons, then pour it into all those vessels, and set aside the full ones.”
So she went from him and shut the door behind her and her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured it out.
Now it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, “Bring me another vessel.” And he said to her, “There is not another vessel.” So the oil ceased.
Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, “Go, sell the oil and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

sections.title: Elisha and the Shunammite woman

verses.text: And it came to pass after this, on a certain day, that Elisha passed to Shunem; and there was a great woman there; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
And she said unto her husband, “Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.”

“Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.”
And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
And he said to Gehazi, “Call this Shunammite.” And when he had called her, she stood before him.

And he said, “Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? Wouldst thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host?” And she answered, “I dwell among mine own people.”
And he said, “What then is to be done for her?” And Gehazi answered, “Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.”
And he said, “Call her.” And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
And he said, “About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son.” And she said, “Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.”
And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
ሕፃኑም አደገ፤ እህል አጫጆችም ወዳሉበት ወደ አባቱ መጣ። አባቱንም፥ “ራሴን ራሴን” አለው፤
አባቱም ሎሌውን፥ “ተሸክመህ ወደ እናቱ ውስደው” አለው።
አንሥቶም ወደ እናቱ ወሰደው፤ በጕልበቷም ላይ እስከ ቀትር ድረስ አስተኛችው፤ ሞተም።
አውጥታም በእግዚአብሔር ሰው አልጋ ላይ አጋደመችው፤ በሩንም ዘግታበት ወጣች።
ባልዋንም ጠርታ፥ “ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ዘንድ በፍጥነት እሄዳለሁና አንድ ሎሌና አንድ አህያ ላክልኝ” አለችው።
እርሱም፥ “መባቻ ወይም ሰንበት ያይደለ ዛሬ ለምን ትሄጃለሽ?” አለ። እርስዋም፥ “ደኅና ነው” አለች።
አህያውንም አስጭና ሎሌዋን፥ “ንዳ፥ ሂድ፤ እኔ ሳላዝዝህ አታዘግየኝ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ቄርሜሎስ ተራራ እንሂድ” አለችው።
እንዲሁም ሄደች፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ሰው ወደ ቀርሜሎስ ተራራ ወጣች። ኤልሳዕም ያችን ሴት ወደ እርሱ ስትመጣ ባያት ጊዜ ሎሌውን ግያዝን፥ “እነኋት፥ ሱማናዊት መጣች፤
አሁንም ሩጥና ተቀበላት፤ በደኅናሽ ነውን? ባልሽ ደኅና ነውን? ልጅሽስ ደኅና ነውን? በላት” አለው። እርስዋም፥ “ደኅና ነው” አለች።
ወደ ተራራውም ወደ ኤልሳዕ ደርሳ እግሮቹን ጨበጠች፤ ግያዝም ሊያርቃት መጣ፤ ኤልሳዕም፥ “ነፍስዋ አዝናለችና ተዋት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ያን ከእኔ ሰውሮታል፤ አልነገረኝምም” አለ።
And she said, "Indeed, shall I not be able to bear a son for my lord? I have not said that you should not be able to bear me."

Elisha commanded, "Wash your face; take your staff in your hand and go; and if you meet anyone, do not greet him; and if he greets you, do not answer him; and lay my staff upon the face of the child."
And the mother of the child said, "As the Lord lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you." So Elisha arose and followed her.

The staff went before them; the staff had already reached them; and it was laid upon the face of the child; however, there was no voice or sound; and he returned to meet him, saying, "The child has not awakened."
And when Elisha came into the house, behold, the child was dead, lying on his bed.
Elisha entered the house and shut the door behind the two of them, and he prayed to the Lord.

And he went up and lay upon the child, putting his mouth upon his mouth, his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands; and he stretched himself upon the child, and the flesh of the child became warm.
He returned and walked in the house once here and once there, and again he went up and stretched himself upon him seven times; and the child opened his eyes.
And he called to Gehazi, saying, "Call this Shunammite." And when he had called her, she came to him, and he said, "Take up your son."
And she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed to the ground; and she took up her son and went out.

sections.title: Elisha performed two miracles as he had done.

verses.text: ኤልሳዕም ዳግመኛ ወደ ጌልጌላ ተመለሰ፤ በምድርም ላይ ራብ ነበረ፤ የነቢያትም ልጆች በፊቱ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ኤልሳዕም ሎሌውን፥ “ታላቁን ምንቸት ጣድ፤ ለነቢያትም ልጆች ቅጠላ ቅጠል አብስልላቸው” አለው።
አንዱም ቅጠላ ቅጠል ያመጣ ዘንድ ወደ ሜዳ ወጣ፤ በምድረ በዳውም የወይን ቦታ አገኘ፤ ከዚያም የምድር ቅጠላ ቅጠል ሰብሰበ፤ ልብሱንም ሞላ፤ መትሮም በወጡ ምንቸት ውስጥ ጨመረው፤ አበሰለውም፤ ምን እንደ ሆነ ግን አላወቁም።
ከዚህም በኋላ ሰዎቹ ይበሉ ዘንድ አቀረበላቸው፤ የበሰለውንም ቅጠል በሚበሉበት ጊዜ፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሆይ፥ በምንቸቱ ውስጥ መርዝ አለ” ብለው ጮኹ፤ ይበሉም ዘንድ አልቻሉም።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “ዶቄት አምጣና በምንቸቱ ውስጥ ጨምረው” አለው፥ ኤልሳዕም ግያዝን፥ “ለሕዝቡ መልስላቸው ይብሉ” አለው። ከዚህም በኋላ በምንቸቱ ውስጥ ክፉ ነገር አልተገኘም።
አንድ ሰውም ከቤትሣሪሳ ከእህሉ ቀዳምያት፥ ሃያ የገብስ እንጀራ፥ የእህልም እሸት በአቁማዳ ይዞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው መጣ፤ ኤልሳዕም አገልጋዩን፥ “ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው” አለ።
ሎሌውም፥ “ይህን እንዴት አድርጌ ለመቶ ሰው አቀርባለሁ?” አለ። እርሱም፥ “ይበላሉ፥ ያተርፋሉም ብሎ እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ይበሉ ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ ስጣቸው” አለው።
እርሱም አቀረበላቸው፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል በሉ፤ አተረፉም።

sections.title: "Faith is like freedom."

verses.text: የሶርያ ንጉሥ ሠራዊት አለቃ ንዕማንም እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ እጅ ለሶርያ ደኅንነትን ስለ ሰጠ፥ በጌታው ዘንድ ታላቅና ክቡር ሰው ነበረ፤ ሰውዬውም ጽኑዕ፥ ኀያል ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን ለምጻም ነበረ።
ከሶርያውያንም ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ በወጣ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ምድር ታናሽ ብላቴና ሴት ማረከ፤ ለሚስቱም አገልጋይ አደረጋት።
እመቤቷንም፥ “ጌታዬ በሰማርያ ወደሚኖረው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ነቢዩ ይሄድ ዘንድ በተገባው ነበር፤ ከለምጹም በፈወሰው ነበር” አለቻት።
ሚስቱም ወደ እርሱ ገብታ፥ “ከእስራኤል ሀገር የመጣች ይች ብላቴና እንደዚህና እንደዚህ አለች” ብላ ነገረችው።
የሶርያም ንጉሥ ንዕማንን፥ “ሂድ፥ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ደብዳቤ እልካለሁ” አለው። እርሱም ሄደ፤ ዐሥርም መክሊት ብር፥ ስድስት ሺህም ወቄት ወርቅ፥ ዐሥርም መለወጫ ልብስ በእጁ ወሰደ።
ወደ እስራኤልም ንጉሥ፦ ደብዳቤውን አደረሰ። ደብዳቤውም እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ደብዳቤው ካንተ ዘንድ በደረሰ ጊዜ ባለሟሌን ንዕማንን ወደ አንተ ልኬዋለሁና ከለምጹ ፈውሰው።”
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ደብዳቤውን ባነበበ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀድዶ፥ “ሰውን ከለምጹ እፈውስ ዘንድ ይህ ሰው ወደ እኔ መስደዱ እኔ በውኑ ለመግደልና ለማዳን የምችል አምላክ ነኝን? ተመልከቱ፥ የጠብ ምክንያት እንደሚፈልግብኝ ተመልከቱ” አለ።
ኤልሳዕም የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ልብሱን እንደ ቀደደ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ “ልብስህን ለምን ቀደድህ? ንዕማን ወደ እኔ ይምጣ፤ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ነቢይ እንዳለ ያውቃል” ብሎ ወደ ንጉሡ ላከ።
ንዕማንም በፈረሱና በሰረገላው መጣ፤ በኤልሳዕም ቤት ደጃፍ ውጭ ቆመ።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሂድ፥ በዮርዳኖስም ሰባት ጊዜ ተጠመቅ፤ ሰውነትህም ይፈወሳል፤ አንተም ንጹሕ ትሆናለህ” ብሎ ወደ እርሱ መልእክተኛ ላከ።
And Naaman departed; and he said, "Behold, there comes to me one who calls upon the name of the Lord my God, and there is none who can cleanse me, as one who dips in the water with his hand."
"Do not the rivers of Damascus, Abana and Pharpar, surpass all the waters of Israel? Could I not wash in them and be clean?" Thus he turned away in anger and went away.

And his servants came near and spoke to him, saying, "My father, if the prophet had commanded you to do something great, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he says to you, 'Wash, and be clean'?"
So Naaman went down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company; and he came and stood before him, and said, "Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel; now therefore, I pray you, take a blessing of your servant."
But Elisha said, "As the Lord lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none." And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

And Naaman said, "I will no longer offer either burnt offering or sacrifice to other gods, but to the Lord. Yet in this thing may the Lord pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon; when I bow down in the house of Rimmon, may the Lord pardon your servant in this matter."
And Elisha said to Naaman, "Go in peace." So he departed from him a little way.
And Elisha said to Naaman, "Go in peace." And he was a short distance from him.

sections.title: As the garment of the rich is received, so is the wealth of the righteous, and as it is with Elisha, so it is with the humble.

verses.text: The servant of Elisha said, "My lord, this Syrian has come to seek this favor; yet, if he should come, I would not receive him at all; as surely as the Lord lives! I will run to him, for I will take nothing from him."
And when he had followed after him, as he was running towards him, he saw him from afar and said, "Is all well?"

And he answered, "All is well: for now there have come to me two young men from the sons of the prophets from the hill country of Ephraim; and I said to my lord, 'Give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.'"

And the servant said, "Take two talents of silver." And he took the two talents of silver and bound them in two bags, along with the two changes of clothing, and he gave them to the two young men, and they went before him.
And when they came to the hill, they took them from their hand and stored them in the house; and they let the men go.
After this, he went in and stood before his lord; and Elisha said, "Gehazi, where did you go?" And he said, "Your servant did not go anywhere."

And he said, "Did not my heart go with you when the man turned back from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money and to receive clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and oxen, male and female servants?"
Nevertheless, the leprosy of Naaman shall cling to you and to your descendants forever." And he went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

sections.title: The miracle that Elisha performed.

verses.text: የነቢያትም ልጆች ኤልሳዕን፥ “እነሆ፥ በፊትህ የምናድርበት ቤት ጠብቦናል።
ወደ ዮርዳኖስም እንሂድ፤ ከእኛም እያንዳንዱ ከዚያ ምሰሶ ያምጣ፥ የምናድርበትም ቤት እንሥራ፥” አሉት፤ እርሱም፥ “ሂዱ” አለ።
ከእነርሱም አንዱ፥ “አንተ ደግሞ ከእኛ ከአገልጋዮችህ ጋር ለመሄድ ና” አለ። ኤልሳዕም፥ “እሽ እኔም እመጣለሁ” አለ።
ከእነርሱም ጋር ሄደ፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም በደረሱ ጊዜ እንጨት ቈረጡ።
ከእነርሱም አንዱ ዛፉን ሲቈርጥ የምሳሩ ብረት ወልቆ ወደ ውኃው ውስጥ ወደቀ፤ እርሱም፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወየው! ወየው! የተዋስሁት ነበር” ብሎ ጮኸ።
የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው፥ “የወደቀው ወዴት ነው?” አለ፤ ስፍራውንም አሳየው፤ ከእንጨትም ቅርፊት ቀርፎ በዚያ ጣለው፤ ብረቱም ተንሳፈፈ።
እርሱም፥ “እነሆ፥ ምሳርህ ውሰደው” አለ፤ እጁንም ዘርግቶ ወሰደው።
የሶርያም ንጉሥ ከእስራኤል ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር፤ ከአገልጋዮቹም ጋር ተማክሮ፥ “በዚህ ስውር ቦታ ተደብቀን እናድራለን።” አላቸው።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሶርያውያን በዚያ ተደብቀዋልና በዚያ ስፍራ እንዳታልፍ ተጠንቀቅ” ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ላከ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኤልሳዕ ወደ ነገረው ስፍራ ላከ፤ አንድ ጊዜም ሳይሆን፥ ሁለት ጊዜም ሳይሆን በዚያ ራሱን አዳነ።
የሶርያም ንጉሥ መንፈስ ስለዚህ እጅግ ተበሳጨች፤ አገልጋዮቹንም ጠርቶ፥ “ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ማን እንደሚነግረው አትነግሩኝምን?” አላቸው።
ከአገልጋዮቹም አንዱ፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ በእስራኤል ሀገር ነቢዩ ኤልሳዕ ያለ አይደለምን? በእልፍኝህ ውስጥ ሆነህ የምትናገረውንና ቃልህን ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ እርሱ ይነግረዋል፤” አለ።
እርሱም፥ “ልኬ አስይዘው ዘንድ ሄዳችሁ ወዴት እንደ ሆነ ዕወቁ፤” አለ። እነርሱም፥ “እነሆ፥ በዶታይን አለ” ብለው ነገሩት።
ወደዚያም ፈረሶችንና ሰረገሎችን ብዙም ጭፍራ ላከ፤ በሌሊትም መጥተው ከተማዪቱን ከበቡአት።
የኤልሳዕም ሎሌ ማለዳ ነቃ፤ ተነሥቶም በወጣ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በከተማዪቱ ዙሪያ ጭፍሮች ከተማዋን ከብበዋት አየ። ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎችም ነበሩ። ሎሌውም፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ወዮ! ምን እናድርግ?” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “ከእኛ ጋር ያሉት ከእነርሱ ጋር ካሉት ይበልጣሉና አትፍራ” አለው።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “አቤቱ፥ ያይ ዘንድ ዐይኖቹን፥ እባክህ፥ ግለጥ” ብሎ ጸለየ። እግዚአብሔርም የብላቴናውን ዐይኖች ገለጠ፤ እነሆም፥ የእሳት ፈረሶችና ሰረገሎች በኤልሳዕ ዙሪያ ተራራውን ሞልተውት አየ።
ወደ እርሱም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ፥ “አቤቱ፥ እነዚህን ሰዎች አሳውራቸው” ብሎ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ። ኤልሳዕም እንደ ተናገረው ቃል አሳወራቸው።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “መንገዱ በዚህ አይደለም፥ ከተማዪቱም ይህች አይደለችም፤ የምትሹትን ሰው አሳያችሁ ዘንድ ተከተሉኝ” አላቸው፤ ወደ ሰማርያም ወሰዳቸው።
ወደ ሰማርያም በገቡ ጊዜ ኤልሳዕ፥ “አቤቱ፥ ያዩ ዘንድ የእነዚህን ሰዎች ዐይኖች ግለጥ” አለ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዐይኖቻቸውን ገለጠ፤ እነርሱም አዩ። እነሆም፥ በሰማርያ መካከል እንዳሉ ዐወቁ።
And when the king of Israel was in distress, Elisha said, "My father, shall I slay them?"

And he answered, "You shall not slay them; would you slay those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink and go to their master."
And he prepared a great feast for them; and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. And the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

sections.title: The king of Syria and the son of Ader besieged Samaria.

verses.text: ከዚያም በኋላ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ሠራዊቱን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ወጥቶም ሰማርያን ከበባት፤ በዚያም ተቀመጠ።
በሰማርያም ታላቅ ራብ ሆኖ ነበር፤ እነሆም፥ የአህያ ራስ በኀምሳ ብር፥ የድርጎ አንድ አራተኛ የሚሆን ኵስሐ ርግብም በአምስት ብር እስኪሽጥ ድረስ ከበቡአት።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በቅጥር ላይ ሲመላለስ አንዲት ሴት፥ “ጌታዬ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ርዳኝ” ብላ ወደ እርሱ ጮኸች።
እርሱም፥ “እግዚአብሔር ካልረዳሽ እኔ እንዴት እረዳሻለሁ? ከአውድማው ወይስ ከመጭመቂያው ነውን?” አለ።
ንጉሡም፥ “ምን ሆነሻል?” አላት፤ እርስዋም፥ “ይህች ሴት፦ ዛሬ እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ፤ ነገም ልጄን እንበላለን አለችኝ።
ልጄንም ቀቅለን በላነው፤ በማግሥቱም፦ እንድንበላው ልጅሽን አምጪ አልኋት፤ ልጅዋንም ሸሸገችው” ብላ መለሰችለት።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ የሴቲቱን ቃል ሰምቶ ልብሱን ቀደደ፤ በቅጥርም ይመላለስ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም በስተውስጥ በሥጋው ላይ ለብሶት የነበረውን ማቅ አዩ።
ንጉሡም፥ “የሣፋጥ ልጅ የኤልሳዕ ራስ ዛሬ በላዩ ያደረ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያድርገኝ እንዲህም ይግደለኝ” አለ።

ኤልሳዕ ግን በቤቱ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ሽማግሌዎችም ከእርሱ ጋር ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ንጉሡም በፊቱ ከሚቆሙት አንድ ሰው ላከ፤ መልእክተኛውም ገና ሳይደርስ ለሽማግሌዎች፥ “ይህ የነፍሰ ገዳይ ልጅ ራሴን ይቈርጥ ዘንድ እንደ ላከ እዩ፤ መልእክተኛውም በመጣ ጊዜ ደጁን ዘግታችሁ ከልክሉት፤ በደጅም ይቆም ዘንድ ተዉት፤ የጌታው የእግሩ ኮቴ በኋላው ነው” አላቸው።
ከእነርሱም ጋር ሲነጋገር እነሆ፥ መልእክተኛው ወደ እርሱ ደረሰ፤ እርሱም፥ “እነሆ፥ ይህ ክፉ ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ገና እጠብቅ ዘንድ ምንድን ነኝ?” አለ።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስማ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ በሰማርያ በር፥ ሁለት መስፈሪያ ገብስ በአንድ ሰቅል አንድ መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄትም በአንድ ሰቅል ይሸመታል” አለው።
ንጉሡም በእጁ ተደግፎት የሚቆም የነበረ ያ ብላቴና ለኤልሳዕ መልሶ፥ “እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ የእህል ሿሿቴ ቢያደርግ ይህ ነገር ይሆናልን?” አለው። ኤልሳዕም፥ “እነሆ፥ በዐይኖችህ ታየዋለህ፤ ከዚያ ግን አትቀምስም” አለ።
በከተማዋም በር አራት ለምጻሞች ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ እርስ በርሳቸውም፥ “እስክንሞት ድረስ በዚህ ለምን እንቀመጣለን?
ወደ ከተማ ብንገባ ራብ በከተማ አለና፥ በዚያ እንሞታለን፤ በዚህም ብንቀመጥ እንሞታለን። እንግዲህ ኑ፥ ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር እንሂድ፤ በሕይወት ቢያኖሩን እንኖራለን፤ ቢገድሉንም እንሞታለን” ተባባሉ።
በጨለማም ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተነሡ፤ ወደ ሶርያውያንም ሰፈር መጀመሪያ ዳርቻ በመጡ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ በዚያ ማንም ሰው አልነበረም።
እግዚአብሔርም ለሶርያውያን የሰረገላ ድምፅ፥ የፈረስ ድምፅና የብዙ ጭፍራ ድምፅ አሰምቶአቸዋልና፥ እርስ በርሳቸው “እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ይከቡን ዘንድ የኬጤዎናውያንንና የግብፃውያንን ነገሥት ቀጥሮ አምጥቶብናል” ይባባሉ ነበር።
ስለዚህም ተነሥተው በጨለማ ሸሹ፤ ድንኳኖቻቸውንና ፈረሶቻቸውን፥ አህዮቻቸውንና ሰፈሩን እንዳለ ትተው ነፍሳቸውን ያድኑ ዘንድ ሸሹ።
እነዚያም ለምጻሞች ወደ ሰፈሩ መጀመሪያ ዳርቻ በመጡ ጊዜ ወደ አንድ ድንኳን ገብተው በሉ፤ ጠጡም፤ ከዚያም ወርቅና ብር ልብስም ወሰዱ፤ ሄደውም ሸሸጉት፤ ተመልሰውም ወደ ሌላ ድንኳን ገቡ፤ ከዚያም ደግሞ ወስደው ሸሸጉ።
ከዚያም ወዲያ እርስ በርሳቸው፥ “መልካም አላደረግንም፤ ዛሬ የመልካም ምሥራች ቀን ነው፤ እኛ ዝም ብለናል፤ እስኪነጋም ድረስ ብንቆይ በደለኞች እንሆናለን፤ ኑ፥ እንሂድ፤ ለንጉሥ ቤተሰብም እንናገር” ተባባሉ።
ገብተውም በከተማው በር ጮኹ፤ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩ፥ “ወደ ሶርያውያን ሰፈር ገባን፤ እነሆም፥ ፈረሶችና አህዮች ታስረው፥ ድንኳኖችም ተተክለው ነበር እንጂ ያገኘነው አልነበረም፤ የሰውም ድምፅ አልነበረም።”
የደጁም ጠባቂዎች ለንጉሡ ይነግሩ ዘንድ ወደ ውስጥ ገቡ፤ ለንጉሡም ቤት አወሩ።
ንጉሡም በሌሊት ተነሥቶ ብላቴኖቹን፥ “ሶርያውያን ያደረጉብንን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ እንደ ተራብን ያውቃሉ፤ ስለዚህ፦ ከከተማይቱ በወጡ ጊዜ በሕይወታቸው እንይዛቸዋለን፤ ወደ ከተማም እንገባለን ብለው በሜዳ ይሸሸጉ ዘንድ ከሰፈሩ ወጥተዋል” አላቸው።
ከብላቴኖቹም አንዱ መልሶ፥ “እዚህ ከቀሩት ፈረሶች አምስት ይውሰዱ፤ እነሆ፥ እነርሱ በቀሩት በእስራኤል ቍጥር ናቸው፥ እንስደድና ይዩ” አለ።
ሁለት ፈረሰኞችንም ወሰዱ፤ የእስራኤል ንጉሥም፥ “ሄዳችሁ እዩ” ብሎ የሶርያውያንን ንጉሥ ይከተሉት ዘንድ ላከ።
በኋላቸውም እስከ ዮርዳኖስ ድረስ ተከትለዋቸው ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ ሶርያውያን ሲሸሹ የጣሉት ልብስና ዕቃ መንገዱን ሁሉ ሞልቶ አገኙ። እነዚያ መልእክተኞችም ተመልሰው ለእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነገሩት።
ሕዝቡም ወጥቶ የሶርያውያንን ሰፈር በዘበዘ፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል አንድ መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄት በአንድ ሰቅል፥ ሁለት መስፈሪያ ገብስም በአንድ ሰቅል ተሸመተ።
ንጉሡም ያን እጁን ይደግፈው የነበረውን ብላቴና በሩን ይጠብቅ ዘንድ አቆመው። ሕዝቡም በበሩ ረገጠው፥ መልእክተኛው ወደ እርሱ በወረደ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው እንደ ተናገረውም ሞተ።
ኤልሳዕም ለንጉሡ፥ “ነገ በዚህ ጊዜ በሰማርያ በር ሁለት መስፈሪያ ገብስ በአንድ ሰቅል፥ አንድ መስፈሪያ መልካም ዱቄትም በአንድ ሰቅል፥ ይሸመታል” ብሎ እንደ ተናገረው ነገር እንዲሁ ሆነ።
ያም ሎሌ ለኤልሳዕ መልሶ፥ “እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሰማይ የእህል ሿሿቴ ቢያወርድ ይህ ነገር ይሆናልን?” ብሎ ነበር፤ ኤልሳዕም፥ “እነሆ፥ በዐይኖችህ ታየዋለህ፥ ከዚያም አትቀምስም” ብሎት ነበር።
እንዲሁም ሆነ፤ ሕዝቡም በበሩ ረገጠውና ሞተ።

sections.title: The return of the woman of Shunem from exile.

verses.text: And Elisha said unto the woman whose son he had restored to life, "Arise, and go thou and thy household, and dwell in the land of the Philistines; for the Lord hath called for a famine, and it shall also come upon the land for seven years."
And the woman arose, and did according to the saying of Elisha; and she went with her household, and dwelt in the land of the Philistines for seven years.
And it came to pass, at the end of the seven years, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines; and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
And the king spake unto Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, saying, "Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done."

And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, "My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life."

And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, "Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now."

sections.title: The prophet Elisha and the king of Syria, the son of Ader.

verses.text: ኤልሳዕም ወደ ደማስቆ ሄደ፤ የሶርያም ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር ታምሞ ነበር፤ “የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደዚህ መጥቶአል” ብለውም ነገሩት።
ንጉሡም አዛሄልን፥ “ገጸ በረከት በእጅህ ወስደህ የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው ተቀበለው፤ ከዚህም በሽታ እድን እንደ ሆነ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ጠይቀው” አለው።
አዛሄልም ሊገናኘው ሄደ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ከደማስቆ መልካሙን ነገር ሁሉ የአርባ ግመል ጭነት ገጸ በረከት ወሰደ፤ መጥቶም በፊቱ ቆመና፥ “ልጅህ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ወልደ አዴር፦ ከዚህ በሽታ እድናለሁን? ሲል ወደ አንተ ልኮኛል” አለው።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “ሂድ፥ መዳንስ ትድናለህ በለው፤ ነገር ግን እንዲሞት እግዚአብሔር አሳይቶኛል” አለው።
እስኪያፍርም ድረስ ትኩር ብሎ ፊቱን ተመለከተው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው አለቀሰ።
አዛሄልም፥ “ጌታዬን ምን ያስለቅሰዋል?” አለ። ኤልሳዕም፥ “በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ የምታደርገውን ክፋት ስለማውቅ ነው፤ ምሽጎቻቸውን በእሳት ታቃጥላለህ፤ ጐልማሶቻቸውንም በሰይፍ ትገድላለህ፤ ሕፃናቶቻቸውንም ትፈጠፍጣለህ፤ እርጉዞቻቸውንም ትሰነጥቃለህ፤” አለው።
አዛሄልም፥ “ይህን ታላቅ ነገር አደርግ ዘንድ እኔ የሞተ ውሻ አገልጋይህ ምንድን ነኝ?” አለ። ኤልሳዕም፥ “አንተ በሶርያ ላይ ንጉሥ እንድትሆን እግዚአብሔር አሳይቶኛል” አለው።
ከኤልሳዕም ወጥቶ ወደ ጌታው መጣ፤ እርሱም፥ “ኤልሳዕ ምን አለህ?” አለው፤ እርሱም አለው፥ “መዳንን ትድናለህ በለው አለኝ።”
ከዚህም በኋላ በነጋው ለሐፍ ወስዶ በውኃ ነከረው፤ በፊቱም ላይ ሸፈነው፥ ሞተም። አዛሄልም በፋንታው ነገሠ።
በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በአክዓብ ልጅ በኢዮራም በአምስተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ኢዮራም በይሁዳ ነገሠ።
And it came to pass, in the beginning of his reign, that he was a king for thirty-two years in Samaria, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
For he was the son of Ahab, and he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, as it is written concerning the kings of Israel; and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.
Nevertheless, for him and for his sons, there was given a light in all his days, as it was promised, and for the sake of his servant David, the Lord did not destroy Judah.
And in his days, the Edomites revolted against Judah, and they made a king over themselves.
And Jehoram passed over with all the chariots, and he rose up and smote the Edomites, who were with him, and the captains of the chariots; but the people fled to their tents.
Yet Edom has been in rebellion against Judah unto this day; and at that time, Libnah also revolted.
Is it not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah concerning all that Jehoram did?
And Jehoram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his son Ahaziah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: Ahaziah reigned in Judah as king.

verses.text: In Israel, in the second year of King Jehoram, the son of Ahab, King Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram of Judah, reigned.
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah, the granddaughter of Omri, king of Israel.
And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, like the house of Ahab had done.
And he went with Jehoram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Jehoram.

And King Jehoram returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramoth, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

sections.title: He is as a ruler over Israel.

verses.text: And the prophet Elisha called one of the sons of the prophets and said unto him, “Take this flask of oil in thy hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead.”

And when thou comest thither, behold, thou shalt find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat, the son of Nimshi; and thou shalt go in and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber.
And thou shalt take the flask of oil and pour it on his head, and say, “Thus saith the Lord: I have anointed thee king over Israel; and thou shalt open the door and flee, and tarry not.”
So the young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead.
And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, “I have a message for thee, O captain.” And Jehu said, “For which of all us?” And he said, “For thee, O captain.”

And he arose and went into the house; and he poured the oil upon his head and said unto him, “Thus saith the Lord God of Israel: I have anointed thee king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.”
And thou shalt strike down the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.
And the whole house of Ahab shall perish; and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel.
And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

And as for Jezebel, the dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel; and him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.” And he opened the door and fled.
And he went to his lord's servants; and they said, "Is it well? Why has this man come to you?" And he said to them, "Do you not know that the man speaks as he pleases?"
And they said, "We have come; but tell us," and he said to the lord's children, "Thus says the Lord: 'You shall be a king over Israel, and I have come to you with this word.'"
And at that time, they all hurried and took their garments; and at the entrance of the gate, they cast them down beneath his feet, and as they fled, they said, "Indeed, he has spoken."

Likewise, the son of Namasi, the son of Jehoshaphat, is he who has come to you. Jehoram and all the children of Israel were keeping watch at Ramoth Gilead, which was taken from the king of Syria, from Ahaziel.

But King Jehoram, when he was engaged with the king of Syria, was returning to Israel, for he had been defeated by the Syrians. He said to those who were with him, "Can you give your lives for me? Beware that no one may escape from your city, and that none may flee into Israel."

The king of Israel, Jehoram, was engaged with the king of Syria, and the Syrians had taken Ramoth, and he returned to Israel. He was seated on the throne and went to Israel. He was a strong and mighty man; and the king of Judah, Ahaziah, had come down to see Jehoram.
And he stood upon the wall of Israel, and when they came, they saw his chariot. "Behold, I have no chariot," he said. And Jehoram said, "Let one horseman go forth; and he said, 'Is it peace?'"

And the horseman went to meet them, saying, "The king says this: 'Is it peace?'" And he said, "What have you to do with peace? Turn back and follow me." And the messenger said, "The messenger has reached them, but he has not returned."
And he sent a second horseman; and when he came to them, the king said, "Is it peace?" And he said, "What have you to do with peace? Turn back and follow me."
And the messenger said, "The messenger has reached them, but he has not returned; but the one who leads them is like the son of Namasi, for he drives furiously."

And Jehoram said, "Prepare the chariots"; and they prepared the chariots for him. And both Jehoram, the king of Israel, and Ahaziah, the king of Judah, went out, each in his chariot, and they went out to meet Jehu; and they found him in the field of Naboth the Jezreelite.
And it came to pass, when Jehoram saw Jehu, that he said, "Is it peace, Jehu?" And he answered, "What peace, so long as the harlotries of your mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?"
And Jehoram turned around and fled, and said to Ahaziah, "Ahaziah, treachery!"
And Jehu drew his bow with full strength and shot Jehoram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he fell down in his chariot.

And he said to his captain, "Take him up, and cast him in the plot of ground of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how that, when I and you rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him."

"Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons," says the LORD; "and I will repay you in this plot," says the LORD. "Now therefore take and cast him into the plot of ground, according to the word of the LORD."

And Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this; and he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, "Shoot him also in the chariot." And they shot at him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulcher with his fathers in the city of David.
In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

sections.title: The slaying of Elzabel.

verses.text: ኢዩም ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ሄደ፤ ኤልዛቤልም ይህን በሰማች ጊዜ ዐይንዋን ተኳለች፤ ራስዋንም አስጌጠች፤ በመስኮትም ዘልቃ ትመለከት ነበር።
ኢዩም ወደ ከተማ በገባ ጊዜ፥ “ጌታውን የገደለ ዘምሪ ሰላም ነውን?” አለችው።
ፊቱንም አቅንቶ በመስኮቱ አያት። “አንቺ ማን ነሽ? ወደዚህ ወደ እኔ ውረጂ” አላት። ከዚህም በኋላ ሁለት ጃንደረቦች ወደ እርሱ ተመለከቱ።
እርሱም፥ “ወደ ታች ወርውሩአት” አላቸው፤ ወረወሩአትም፥ ደምዋም በግንቡና በፈረሶች መግሪያ ላይ ተረጨ፥ ረገጡአትም።
ኢዩም ገብቶ በላ፤ ጠጣም፥ ከዝያም በኋላ፥ “ሂዱ፥ ይህችን የተረገመች እዩአት፤ የንጉሥ ልጅ ናትና ቅበሩአት” አለ።
ሊቀብሩአትም በሄዱ ጊዜ ከአናቷና ከእግርዋ ተረከዝ ከመዳፍዋም በቀር ምንም አላገኙም።
ተመልሰውም ለኢዩ ነገሩት፤ እርሱም፥ “በባሪያው በቴስብያዊው ኤልያስ እጅ በኢይዝራኤል እርሻ የኤልዛቤልን ሥጋ ውሾች ይበላሉ፥
የኤልዛቤልም ሬሳ በኢይዝራኤል እርሻ መሬት ላይ እንደ ፍግ ይሆናልና ማንም፦ ይህች ኤልዛቤል ናት ይል ዘንድ አይችልም ብሎ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው” አለ።

sections.title: As the children of Akab were slain.

verses.text: And Ahab had seven sons in Samaria; and he sent a letter, to inform the sons of Ahab, to the rulers and elders of Samaria.
Thus it was said, “This letter has now reached you at the time when your lord's sons, their chariots and horses, and the cities that have been fortified, and the weapons of war are with you;
Choose that which brings joy and is pleasing to you from the sons of your lord; and place them upon the throne of their father; and contend for the house of your lord.”
And they were greatly afraid, and they said, “Behold, the two kings stand before us; how then can we stand before them?”

And the rulers of Ahab's house, and the rulers of the city, and the elders and the guardians said, “We are your servants; and all that you command us we will do; there is no man whom we can speak against; do as you see fit.”

After this, he said, “And if you are indeed my kin, take the heads of your lord's sons and come to me; but at this hour, come to Israel with me,” and he wrote them another letter. And the king's sons were seven men in the presence of the rulers of the city.
And when the letter reached them, the men of the land took the king's sons, seven men, and killed them; and they made their own heads as a trophy and sent them to him in Israel.
And the messenger came and said, “The king's sons have been brought and killed,” and the king said, “Until tomorrow, let two heads be placed at the entrance of the gate.”

And in the evening, the king arose and stood, and all the people said, “You are righteous; behold, I am the one who has caused the house of my lord to be destroyed; who is it that has slain all these?”

Behold, the Lord spoke concerning the house of Ahab, saying, “Let nothing fall to the ground from the word of the Lord; now know this: the Lord has done according to the word spoken by His servant Elijah.”
And he did not leave any of those who remained in Israel from the house of Ahab, neither the great ones nor the close friends nor the priests; he struck them all down; he left not one of them.

sections.title: The days of Ahaziah, as they were slain.

verses.text: And he arose and went to Samaria; and as he was on the way, when he came to the house of the keepers of the sheep,

He met with the king of Judah, with Ahaziah and his brethren, and said, "Who are you?" And they answered, "We are the brethren of Ahaziah, the king of Judah; we are come to seek the welfare of the king's sons and the sons of the queen."
And he commanded, saying, "Take them alive." And in the house of the keepers of the sheep, they slew forty-two men; and there was not left of them one man.

And as he went on his way, he found Jehonadab the son of Rechab; and he greeted him, and said, "Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?" And Jehonadab answered, "It is." And he said, "If it be true, give me your hand." And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
"You are with me, as the Lord lives, and as I am about to serve the Lord," he said. And he made him ride with him in the chariot.
And he came to Samaria, and did unto Elisha as the Lord had spoken, and he smote all that remained in Samaria of the house of Ahab, until he had destroyed it.

sections.title: All who observe the feast are as if they are slain.

verses.text: And he gathered all the people, saying, “You have regarded the feast as a little thing; yet it is regarded greatly by many.”

“Now all the prophets of the feast, and all the servants, and all the priests, come to me; let none be left behind; for I shall offer a great sacrifice for the feast; and all that remain shall not live,” he said. Yet he did this to destroy the servants of the feast.
And he said, “Cleanse your sacrifices for the feast.” And they spoke a decree.

And he sent to all the cities of Israel; and all the servants of the feast, and all the priests, and all the prophets came. Not one man was left behind from among them; all entered into the house of the feast; and the house of the feast was filled from door to door.
And he commanded the house of the goods, saying, “Bring forth the garments for all the servants of the feast.” And he brought forth their garments for them.
And Jonadab the son of Rechab entered into the house of the feast. And the servants of the feast said, “Look, let none among you be found who offers to the Lord except the servants of the feast.”

And they entered to offer the sacrifices that were to be offered; and he said, “If one of you is found who has offered, let his soul be delivered to the place where he has offered.” And he was preparing the people outside.

And when they had offered the sacrifices, he said to the captains and the guards, “Go in and kill them; let none escape.” And they killed them with the sword; and the guards and captains cast them outside; and they went to the house of the feast.
And they brought out the captains from the house of the feast; and they were slain.
They struck down the captains of the feast; and they burned the house of the feast; even to this day they have made a desolation.
Thus, he caused the feast to be abolished from Israel.
Nevertheless, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin; he did not remove the golden calves that were in Bethel and in Dan.
And the Lord said, "Because you have done this in my sight, and have done all that is in your heart, behold, your children shall sit upon the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation."
Yet he did not take heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart; he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which caused Israel to sin.
In those days, the Lord began to cut Israel short; and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel.

All the land of Gilead, which is beyond the Jordan eastward, from Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, and the land of Gad, and the land of Reuben, and the land of Manasseh, all the region of Gilead and Bashan he smote.
Is it not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel, concerning all the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and all his might, and the things which he wrought?
He slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and his son Zechariah reigned in his stead.
And the time that he reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

sections.title: The Queen of Judah, Gotaliah.

verses.text: And when the mother of Ahaziah, Athaliah, saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed of the kingdom.

And Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain; and they hid him and his nurse in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
And he was hid with them in the house of the Lord six years: and Athaliah did reign over the land.

And in the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the Lord, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the Lord, and showed them the king's son.
And he commanded them, saying, “This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;
And another third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and another third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.”

And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king when he goeth out and when he cometh in.”

And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
And the priest gave to the captains of the hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David's, which were in the house of the Lord.
And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, round about the king.
And all the soldiers, each one bearing his weapon in his hand, stood around the king, from the right side of the house to the left side, by the altar and by the house.
And they brought forth the king's son, and they crowned him, and gave him the testimony; and they anointed him, and said, “Long live the king!” And they clapped their hands with joy.
And when Jehoiada heard the voice of the people, he went into the house of the Lord.

And behold, the king stood by the pillar, as was the custom, and the captains and the trumpeters were by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and the trumpets sounded. And Jehoiada put on his vestments and cried out, “Treason! Treason!”

And the priest Jehoiada commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the host, saying, “Bring her out between the ranks; and let him who follows her be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Slay her not in the house of the Lord.”
And they laid hold of her, and went by the way of the entrance of the horses to the king's house; and there they slew her.

sections.title: The change that the priest Yodahe made.

verses.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the people, that they should be the Lord's people; and also between the king and the people.

And all the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down; they thoroughly smashed its altars and images, and killed the priests of Baal before the altars. And the priest Jehoiada appointed the guards of the house of the Lord.

And they took the captains and the Karaites, and the guards, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from the house of the Lord; and they went by the way of the gate of the guards to the king's house; and they set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
And all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was quiet. And they killed Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.
And Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.

sections.title: King Joash of Judah

verses.text: In the seventh year of Jehoash, he began to reign; and he reigned for forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
And Jehoash did what was right in the sight of the Lord all the days that Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
But the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

And Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money that is brought into the house of the Lord, the money for which each man is assessed, and the money that comes into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the Lord,
let each man take it for himself, and let them repair the damages of the house of the Lord.”
Nevertheless, the priests did not repair the damages of the house until the twenty-third year of King Jehoash.

Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest and the other priests, and said to them, “Why are you not repairing the damages of the house? Now therefore, do not take any more money from your acquaintances, but hand it over for repairing the damages of the house.”
And the priests agreed that they would neither take money from the people nor repair the damages of the house.

But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar on the right side as one comes into the house of the Lord; and the priests who kept the door put there all the money brought into the house of the Lord.

So it was, whenever they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up and put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.

And the gathered funds were to be given into the hands of those who serve, and who keep the house of the Lord. They were to be given to the builders and the laborers who work on the house of the Lord.
And for those who would build the house of the Lord, they were to purchase stones and wood, that they might be given to the builders and to the stone masons.
However, concerning the money that was brought into the house of the Lord, there were not made silver vessels, and bowls, and cups, nor any golden or silver articles.
Nevertheless, it was to be given to those who would build; they were to take care of the house of the Lord.
And they were to pay the workers, that those who received the money would not be reproached; for they were to work with faithfulness.
Concerning the offerings for sin and for transgression that were brought into the house of the Lord, they were for the priests.
And in those days, the king of Syria, Ahaziel, arose; and he went forth and besieged; and Ahaziel set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

And Joash, the king of Judah, the son of his fathers, the kings of Judah, Jehoshaphat and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, took all the holy things that had been dedicated, and he took all the gold that was found in the house of the Lord and in the king's house, and sent it to the king of Syria, to Ahaziel. And he returned from Jerusalem.
And concerning the matter of Joash, and all that he did, behold, is it not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
And the servants arose and conspired against him, and in the way as he went down to Sila, they struck him in the house of Millo.

And the servants of Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and the son of Samaria, Jehoash, were slain; and they died, and were buried in the city of David with their fathers; and his son Amaziah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: King Joash of Israel

verses.text: In the seventeenth year of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign in Samaria; and he reigned seventeen years.
And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not from them.
And the Lord was angry with Israel, and delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
And Jehoahaz besought the Lord; and the Lord hearkened unto him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
And the Lord gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
Nevertheless, they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin; but walked therein; and there remained the grove also in Samaria.
For he left of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; but he walked therein.
Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah, with which he contended against Amaziah, king of Judah?
And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne; and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

sections.title: The Death of the Prophet Elisha

verses.text: ኤልሳዕም በሚሞትበት በሽታ ታመመ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ ወደ እርሱ ወርዶ በፊቱ አለቀሰና፥ “አባቴ ሆይ፥ አባቴ ሆይ፥ የእስራኤል ሰረገላቸውና ፈረሰኛቸው” አለ።
ኤልሳዕም፥ “ቀስትህንና ፍላጻዎችህን ውሰድ” አለው፤ ቀስቱንና ፍላጻዎቹንም ወሰደ።
የእስራኤልንም ንጉሥ አለው፥ “እጅህን በቀስቱ ላይ ጫን።” ዮአስም እጁን በቀስቱ ላይ ጫነ፤ ኤልሳዕም እጁን በንጉሡ እጅ ላይ ጫነ፦
“የምሥራቁንም መስኮት ክፈት” አለ፤ ከፈተውም። ኤልሳዕም፥ “ወርውር” አለው፤ ወረወረውም እርሱም፥ “የእግዚአብሔር መድኀኒት ፍላጻ ነው፤ ከሶርያ የመዳን ፍላጻ ነው፤ እስክታጠፋቸውም ድረስ ሶርያውያንን በአፌቅ ትመታለህ” አለ።
ኤልሳዕም ደግሞ፥ “ፍላጻዎችህን ውሰድ” አለው ወሰዳቸውም። የእስራኤልንም ንጉሥ፥ “ምድሩን ምታው” አለው። ንጉሡም ሦስት ጊዜ መትቶ ቆመ።
የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው አዝኖ፥ “አምስት ወይም ስድስት ጊዜ መትተኸው ቢሆን ኖሮ ሶርያውያንን እስክታጠፋቸው ድረስ በመታኻቸው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ሦስት ጊዜ ብቻ ሶርያን ትመታለህ” አለ።
ኤልሳዕም ሞተ፤ ቀበሩትም። ከሞዓብም አደጋ ጣዮች በየዓመቱ መጀመሪያ ወደ ሀገሩ ይገቡ ነበር።
ሰዎችም አንድ ሰው ሲቀብሩ አደጋ ጣዮችን አዩ፤ ሬሳውንም በኤልሳዕ መቃብር ላይ ጣሉት፤ የኤልሳዕንም አጥንት በነካ ጊዜ ሰውዬው ድኖ በእግሩ ቆመ።
አዛሄልም በኢዮአካዝ ዘመን ሁሉ እስራኤልን አስጨነቀ፤
እግዚአብሔር ግን ራራላቸው፤ ማራቸውም፤ ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ፥ ከያዕቆብም ጋር ስላደረገው ቃል ኪዳን እነርሱን ተመለከተ፤ ሊያጠፋቸውም አልወደደም፤ ፈጽሞም ከፊቱ አልጣላቸውም።
And the king of Syria, Ahaziel, died; and his son, and the son of Adar, reigned in his stead.

And Ahaziel, from the hand of his father, Joash, who had taken the cities which Joash had captured, returned and took them from the hand of Ahaziel, the son of Adar. And Joash smote them three times; and he returned the cities of Israel.

sections.title: King Amaziah of Judah

verses.text: በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በኢዮአካዝ ልጅ በዮአስ በሁለተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአስ ልጅ አሜስያስ ነገሠ።
መንገሥም በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው ሃያ አምስት ዓመት ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ። እናቱም ዮአድም የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን አባቱ ኢዮአስ እንዳደረገ ሁሉ እንጂ እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት አላደረገም።
ነገር ግን በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎች አላስወገደም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ ባሉት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።
መንግሥቱም በእጁ በጸናለት ጊዜ አባቱን የገደሉትን አገልጋዮች ገደለ።
በሙሴ ሕግ መጽሐፍም እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ሁሉ በኀጢአቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች ስለ ልጆች አይሙቱ፤ ልጆችም ስለ አባቶች አይሙቱ” ብሎ እንዳዘዘ የነፍሰ ገዳዮቹን ልጆች አልገደላቸውም።
እርሱም በጨው ሸለቆ ከኤዶምያስ ዐሥር ሺህ ሰው ገደለ፤ ሴላንም በጦርነት ወስዶ ስምዋን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ “ዮቅትኤል” ብሎ ጠራት።
በዚያን ጊዜም አሜስያስ፥ “ና እርስ በርሳችን ፊት ለፊት እንተያይ” ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዩ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ወደ ዮአስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዮአስ፥ “የሊባኖስ ኵርንችት፦ ልጅህን ለልጄ ሚስት አድርገህ ስጠው ብሎ ወደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ላከ፤ የሊባኖስም አውሬ አልፎ ኵርንችቱን ረገጠ።
ኤዶምያስን በእውነት መታህ፤ ልብህንም ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፤ በዚያ ተመካ፤ በቤትህም ተቀመጥ፤ አንተ፥ ይሁዳም ከአንተ ጋር ትወድቁ ዘንድ ስለ ምን መከራን ትሻለህ?” ብሎ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሜስያስ ላከ።
Amaziah, however, did not listen; for the king of Israel, Joash, had come up, and he and the king of Judah, Amaziah, met face to face in Beth Shemesh.
And Judah was struck down before Israel, and every man fled to his tent.

And the king of Israel, Joash, captured Amaziah the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, the king of Judah, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate, four hundred cubits.
And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord and in the treasuries of the king's house; and he took hostages, and returned to Samaria.
And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
And Joash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and his son Jeroboam reigned in his stead.
And Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived after the death of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.
And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
And they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and killed him there.
And they brought him upon horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
And all the people of Judah took Azariah, who had been sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.
And the king rested with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David; and Jehoash his son reigned in his stead.

sections.title: King Jeroboam of Israel

verses.text: በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በኢዮአስ ልጅ በአሜስያስ በዐሥራ አምስተኛው ዓመተ መንግሥት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የዮአስ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ አርባ አንድ ዓመትም ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ እስራኤልንም ካሳታቸው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኀጢአት ሁሉ አልራቀም።
በጋትሔፌር በነበረው በአማቴ ልጅ በባሪያው በነቢዩ በዮናስ አፍ እንደ ተናገረው እንደ እስራኤል አምላክ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል የእስራኤልን ድንበር ከሔማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ዓረባ ባሕር ድረስ መለሰ።
በቍጥር እንዳነሱ፥ የታሰረውና የተለቀቀውም እንደ ጠፋ፥ እስራኤልንም የሚረዳ እንዳልነበረ እግዚአብሔር እጅግ የመረረውን የእስራኤልን ጭንቀት አየ።
እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ዘር ከሰማይ በታች ይደመስስ ዘንድ አልተናገረም፤ ነገር ግን በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም እጅ አዳናቸው።
የቀረውም የኢዮርብዓም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ሁሉ፥ ኀይሉም፥ የይሁዳ የነበረውን ደማስቆንና ሔማትን ለእስራኤል እንደ መለሰ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
ኢዮርብዓምም እንደ አባቶቹ እንደ እስራኤል ነገሥታት አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ዘካርያስ በፋንታው ነገሠ።
በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በኢዮርብዓም በሃያ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የአሜስያስ ልጅ ዓዛርያስ ነገሠ።
ዓዛርያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የዐሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ኮልያ የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።
አባቱ አሜስያስ እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።
ነገር ግን በኮረብቶች ላይ የነበሩትን መስገጃዎች አላስወገደም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና በኮረብቶች ላይ በነበሩት መስገጃዎች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።
እግዚአብሔርም ንጉሡን በደዌ ዳሰሰው፤ እስከሚሞትበትም ቀን ለምጻም ሆነ፤ በተለየ ቤትም ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ የንጉሡም ልጅ ኢዮአታም በንጉሡ ቤት ላይ ሠልጥኖ ለሀገሩ ሕዝብ ይፈርድ ነበር።
የቀረውም የዓዛርያስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳ ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
ዓዛርያስም እንደ አባቶቹ አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በሠላሳ ስምንተኛው ዓመት የኢዮርብዓም ልጅ ዘካርያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ስድስት ወር ነገሠ።
አባቶቹም እንዳደረጉት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልንም ካሳታቸው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኀጢአት አልራቀም።
የኢያቢስም ልጅ ሴሎም፤ ሌሎችም ከዱት፤ በይብልዓም መትተው ገደሉት፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ሴሎም ነገሠ።
And concerning the matter of Zechariah, behold, is it not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
To Iyu, it was said, "Your sons shall sit upon the throne of Israel until the fourth generation," thus was the word of the Lord; and so it was.
In Judah, during the reign of Azariah, in the thirty-seventh year, Selum, the son of Jebiah, reigned; and in Samaria, he reigned for one month.
And Menahem, the son of Gadi, went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria; and he struck Selum, the son of Jebiah, in Samaria, and killed him; and he reigned in his stead.
And concerning Selum, behold, is it not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?

At that time, Menahem struck Tirzah and all that were therein; and he smote her doorposts, for they did not open to him, and he killed them; and he took all the women that were there and ravaged them.
In the thirty-seventh year of Azariah, king of Judah, Menahem, the son of Gadi, reigned over Israel in Samaria for ten years.
And he did evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
In his time, Pul, king of Assyria, came up against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

And Menahem gave the king of Assyria a thousand talents of silver, that he might place it upon every mighty man in Israel; and the king of Assyria returned and went back to his own land, and did not remain there.
የቀረውም የምናሔም ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
ምናሔምም እንደ አባቶቹ አንቀላፋ፤ ልጁም ፋቂስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በአምሳኛው ዓመት የምናሔም ልጅ ፋቂስያስ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ ሁለት ዓመትም ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኀጢአትም አልራቀም።
የሠራዊቱም አለቃ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ከዳው፤ በሰማርያም በንጉሡ ቤት ግንብ ውስጥ ከአርጎብና ከአርያ ጋር መታው፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ከገለዓዳውያን አምሳ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ገደለውም፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።
የቀረውም የፋቂስያስ ነገር፥ የሠራውም ሥራ ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት የታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በዓዛርያስ በአምሳ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ መንገሥ ጀመረ፤ ሃያ ዓመትም ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገርን አደረገ፤ እስራኤልን ካሳተው ከናባጥ ልጅ ከኢዮርብዓም ኀጢአትም አልራቀም።
በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በፋቁሔ ዘመን የአሶር ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር መጣ፤ ኢዮንና አቤልቤትመዓካን፥ ያኖዋንም፥ ቃዴስንና አሶርንም፥ ገለዓድንና ገሊላንም፥ የንፍታሌምንም ሀገር ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ወደ አሶርም አፈለሳቸው።
በዖዝያንም ልጅ በኢዮአታም በሃያኛው ዓመት የኤላ ልጅ ሆሴዕ በሮሜልዮ ልጅ በፋቁሔ ላይ ዐመፀበት፤ መትቶም ገደለው፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ነገሠ።
Is it not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel concerning the matters that remain and all the works that he did?
In Israel, Joatham, the son of Ahaz, the king of Judah, reigned during the second year of the reign of Romeliah's son.
He reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem, and his mother was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
Nevertheless, he did not remove the high places; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places. He also made the door of the house of the Lord.
Is it not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah concerning the matters that remain and all the works that he did?
In those days, the Lord began to send against Judah Rezin, the king of Syria, and Pekah, the son of Romeliah.
And Joatham became like his fathers, and he was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his son Ahaz reigned in his stead.

sections.title: King Ahaz of Judah

verses.text: በሮሜልዩ ልጅ በፋቁሔ በዐሥራ ሰባተኛው ዓመት የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮአታም ልጅ አካዝ ነገሠ።
አካዝ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ዐሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በታማኝነት ቅን ነገርን አላደረገም።
ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳሳደዳቸው እንደ አሕዛብ ርኵሰት ልጁን በእሳት ሠዋው።
በመስገጃዎቹና በኮረብቶቹ ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ይሠዋና ያጥን ነበር።
ያን ጊዜም የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶንና የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ ሊዋጉ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጡ፤ አካዝንም ከበቡት፥ ሊያሸንፉት ግን አልቻሉም።
በዚያም ዘመን የሶርያ ንጉሥ ረአሶን ኤላትን ወደ ሶርያ መለሰላቸው፥ አይሁድንም ከኤላት አሳደደ፤ ኤዶማውያንም ወደ ኤላት መጥተው እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ በዚያ ይኖራሉ።
አካዝም፥ “እኔ ባሪያህና ልጅህ ነኝ፤ መጥተህ ከተነሡብኝ ከሶርያ ንጉሥና ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ እጅ አድነኝ” ብሎ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ወደ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶር መልእክተኞችን ላከ።
አካዝም በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በንጉሡ ቤተ መዛግብት የተገኘውን ብርና ወርቅ ወስዶ ወደ አሦር ንጉሥ ገጸ በረከት አድርጎ ሰደደው።
የአሦርም ንጉሥ ሰማው፤ የአሦርም ንጉሥ ወደ ደማስቆ ወጣ፤ ያዛትም፤ ሕዝብዋንም ወደ ቂር አፈለሳቸው፤ ረአሶንንም ገደለው።
የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አካዝም የአሦርን ንጉሥ ቴልጌልቴልፌልሶርን ሊገናኘው ወደ ደማስቆ ሄደ፤ በደማስቆ የነበረውንም መሠዊያ አየ፤ ንጉሡም አካዝ የመሠዊያውን ምሳሌና የአሠራሩን መልክ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ ኦርያ ላከው።
And the priest Uriah did all that King Ahaz commanded, and he made the altar according to all that he had sent from Damascus; thus did Uriah the priest until King Ahaz came from Damascus.
And when the king came from Damascus, he saw the altar; and the king went to the altar and approached it.
He removed the burnt offerings and the meat offerings, and he poured out the drink offerings; and the blood of the peace offerings he sprinkled upon the altar.
And he removed the brazen altar that was before the LORD, from the front of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and he set it on the north side of the altar.

And King Ahaz said, "The burnt offerings of the morning and the evening, and the meat offerings of the king, and the meat offerings of the people, which are to be offered upon the great altar, let them be brought; and all the blood of the burnt offerings and all the blood of the sacrifices let it be poured upon it; but the altar which is for me shall be for the daily offerings," and he commanded the priest Uriah accordingly.
And the priest Uriah did according to all that King Ahaz commanded.
And King Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and he took down the sea from off the brazen oxen that were under it, and set it upon a pavement of stones.
And he built the foundation of the house of the LORD, and he made a door for the king's entry without, and he turned it toward the house of the LORD.
And behold, what King Ahaz did is written in the book of the kings of Judah; is it not so?
And Ahaz was like his fathers, and he was buried with them in the city of David; and his son Hezekiah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: King Hosea of Israel

verses.text: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አካዝ በነገሠ በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ዓመት የኤላ ልጅ ሆሴዕ በእስራኤል ላይ በሰማርያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ አስቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩት እንደ እስራኤል ነገሥታት አልሆነም።
የአሦርም ንጉሥ ስልምናሶር በእርሱ ላይ ዘመተ፤ ሆሴዕም ተገዛለት፤ ግብርም አመጣለት።
የአሦርም ንጉሥ በሆሴዕ ላይ ዐመፅ አገኘ፤ መልእክተኞችን ወደ ግብፅ ንጉሥ ወደ ሴጎር ልኮ ነበርና፤ እንደ ልማዱም በየዓመቱ ለአሦር ንጉሥ ግብር አልሰጠምና፤ ስለዚህ የአሦር ንጉሥ ተዋጋው፤ ይዞም በወህኒ ቤት አሰረው።

sections.title: The fall of the kingdom of the ten tribes.

verses.text: የአሦርም ንጉሥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ወጣ፤ ወደ ሰማርያም ወጥቶ ሦስት ዓመት ከበባት።
በሆሴዕም በዘጠነኛው ዓመት የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰማርያን ያዘ፤ እስራኤልንም ወደ አሶር አፈለሰ፤ በአላሔና በአቦር፤ በጎዛንም ወንዝ፤ በሜዶንም ከተሞች አኖራቸው።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከግብፅ ንጉሥ ከፈርዖን እጅ፥ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣቸውን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን በድለው ነበርና፥ ሌሎችንም አማልክት አምልከው ነበርና፤
እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት በአሳደዳቸው በአሕዛብ ሥርዐት፥ የእስራኤልም ነገሥታት ባደረጓት ሥርዐት ሄደው ነበርና እንደዚህ ሆነ።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች በአምላካቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ቅን ያልሆነን ነገር በስውር አደረጉ፤ በከተሞቻቸውም ሁሉ ከዘበኞች ግንብ ጀምሮ እስከ ተመሸገች ከተማ ድረስ በከፍታዎች ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠሩ።
በረጃጅሙ ኮረብታ ሁሉ ላይ፥ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ሐውልቶችንና የማምለኪያ ዐምዶችን ተከሉ፤
እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው ያወጣቸው አሕዛብ እንዳደረጉት፥ በኮረብቶቹ መስገጃዎች ሁሉ ላይ ያጥኑ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ያስቈጡ ዘንድ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንና ሐውልቶችን አደረጉ፤
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ይህን አታድርጉ” ብሎ የከለከላቸውን ጣዖቶች አመለኩ።
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ከክፉ መንገዳችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ለአባቶቻችሁም እንዳዘዝሁት፥ በባሪያዎቼ በነቢያት የላክሁላችሁን ትእዛዜንና ሥርዐቴን፥ ሕጌንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ” ብሎ በነቢዩ ሁሉና በባለ ራእዩ አፍ ሁሉ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ መሰከረ።
ነገር ግን አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን እንዳላመኑ ከአባቶቻቸው አንገት ይልቅ አንገታቸውን አደነደኑ እንጂ አልሰሙም።
የገባላቸውንም ቃል ኪዳን ሁሉ አልጠበቁም። ከንቱ ነገርንም ተከተሉ፤ ከንቱም ሆኑ፤ እንደ እነርሱም እንዳይሠሩ ያዘዛቸውን በዙሪያቸው ያሉትን አሕዛብ ተከተሉ።
የአምላካቸውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ተዉ፤ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም የሁለቱን እንቦሶች ምስሎች አደረጉ፤ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ተከሉ፤ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገዱ፤ በዓልንም አመለኩ።
ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውንም በእሳት ሥዉአቸው፤ ምዋርተኞችና አስማተኞችም ሆኑ፤ ያስቈጡትም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር ለማድረግ ራሳቸውን ሸጡ።
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ እጅግ ተቈጣ፤ ከፊቱም ጣላቸው፤ ከይሁዳም ነገድ ብቻ በቀር ማንም አልቀረም።
ይሁዳም ደግሞ እስራኤል ባደረጋት ሥርዐት ሄደ እንጂ የአምላኩን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ አልጠበቀም፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ተዉት።
እግዚአብሔርም በእስራኤል ዘር ሁሉ ተቈጣ፤ አስጨነቃቸውም፤ ከፊቱም እስኪጥላቸው ድረስ በበዝባዦች እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።
እስራኤልም ከዳዊት ቤት ተለዩ፤ የናባጥንም ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምን አነገሡ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል እስራኤልን መለሰ፤ ታላቅም ኀጢአት አሠራቸው።
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢዮርብዓም ባደረገው ኀጢአት ሁሉ ሄዱ፤
እግዚአብሔርም በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያት ሁሉ አፍ እንደ ተናገረው እስራኤልን ከፊቱ እስኪያወጣ ድረስ ከእርስዋ አልራቁም። እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከምድሩ ወደ አሦር ፈለሰ።
የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከባቢሎንና ከኩታ፥ ከአዋና ከሐማት፥ ከሴፌርዋይም ሰዎችን አመጣ፤ በእስራኤልም ልጆች ፋንታ በሰማርያ ከተሞች አኖራቸው፤ ሰማርያንም ወረሱአት፤ በከተሞችዋም ተቀመጡ።
በዚያም መቀመጥ በጀመሩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አይፈሩትም ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔርም አንበሶችን ሰደደባቸው፤ ይገድሉአቸውም ነበር።
ስለዚህም ለአሦር ንጉሥ፥ “ያፈለስኻቸው፥ በሰማርያም ከተሞች ያኖርኻቸው ሕዝቦች የሀገሩን አምላክ ሕግ አላወቁም፤ የሀገሩን አምላክ ሕግ አላወቁምና አንበሶችን ሰድዶባቸዋል፤ እነሆም፥ እየገደሉአቸው ነው” ብለው ተናገሩት።
የአሦርም ንጉሥ፥ “ከዚያ ካመጣኋቸው ካህናት አንዱን ውሰዱ፤ ሄዶም በዚያ ይቀመጥ፤ የሀገሩንም አምላክ ሕግ ያስተምራቸው” ብሎ አዘዘ።
ከሰማርያም ካፈለሱአቸው ካህናት አንዱን ወስደው በቤቴል አኖሩት፤ ያም ካህን እግዚአብሔርን እንዴት እንደሚፈሩት ያስተምራቸው ነበር።
በየሕዝባቸውም አምላኮቻቸውን አደረጉ፤ ሳምራውያንም በሠሯቸው በኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሚኖሩባቸው ከተሞቻቸው አኖሩአቸው።
የባቢሎንም ሰዎች ሴኬቤቴናሆምን ሠሩ፤ የኩታም ሰዎች ኤርጌትን ሠሩ፤
የሐማትም ሰዎች አሲማትን ሠሩ፤ አዋውያንም ኤልባዝርንና ተርታቅን ሠሩ፤ የሴፌርዋይም ሰዎች ለሴፌርዋይም አማልክት ለአድራሜሌክና ለአኔሜሌክ ልጆቻቸውን በእሳት ይሠዉ ነበር።
እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በሚኖሩበት ከተማ በሰማርያ በሠሩት በከፍታው ቦታ ጣዖቶቻቸውን አኖሩ። እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ከመካከላቸውም ለኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ካህናትን አደረጉ፤ በኮረብታውም መስገጃዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።
እግዚአብሔርንም ሲፈሩ ከመካከላቸው እንደ ፈለሱት እንደ አሕዛብ ልማድ አምላካቸውን ያመልኩ ነበር።
እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እንደ ልማዳቸው ያደርጋሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ይፈራሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስራኤል ብሎ የጠራውን የያዕቆብን ልጆች እንዳዘዛቸው ሥርዐትና ፍርድ፥ ሕግና ትእዛዝም ያደርጋሉ።
And the Lord made a covenant with them, saying, “Fear not other gods; neither shall ye bow yourselves to them; nor serve them; nor sacrifice to them.
But rather, fear the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm; Him shall ye serve, and to Him shall ye cleave.
Keep therefore the statutes and judgments, and the law and the commandments, which I command you this day, to do them for all time; and fear not other gods.
Ye shall not forget the covenant which the Lord your God made with you, neither shall ye fear other gods.
But fear the Lord your God; for He will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
Nevertheless, do not listen to their practices.
And these nations feared the Lord; moreover, they served their graven images; their children and their children's children did as their fathers had done, even unto this day.

sections.title: King Hezekiah of Judah

verses.text: And it came to pass that Hosea, the son of Elah, became king of Israel in the third year of King Hezekiah, the son of Ahaz, king of Judah.
At the beginning of his reign, he was a mere twenty-five years old; and he reigned in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years; and his mother was named Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father David had done.

He removed the high places and broke the sacred pillars, and cut down the wooden images; and he broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made; for until those days the children of Israel burned incense to it, and he called it Nehushtan.
And he trusted in the Lord God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor who were before him.
For he held fast to the Lord, and did not depart from following Him, but kept His commandments, which the Lord had commanded Moses.
And the Lord was with him; he prospered wherever he went; and he rebelled against the king of Assyria and did not serve him.
He defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory, from the watchtower to the fortified city.
In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea, the son of Elah, king of Israel, Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, came up against Samaria and besieged it.
And at the end of three years they took it; in the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea, king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
And the king of Assyria did send Israel away to Assyria; and they dwelt in the cities of the Medes, by the river of Gozan, and in Halah, and by the gods of their fathers.
For they did not hearken to the word of their God, the Lord, and they broke His covenant; neither did they hearken to all that His servant Moses had commanded them; they did not do it.
And Hezekiah, in the fourteenth year of his reign, went forth to all the cities of Judah and besieged them, and he smote them.

And Hezekiah, king of Judah, sent messengers to the king of Assyria, saying, "I am in distress; return to me, and I will carry all that you desire." And the king of Assyria laid upon Hezekiah, king of Judah, three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
And Hezekiah gave all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord and in the treasures of the king's house.
At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which he had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

And the king of Assyria sent his commanders and his great army against Hezekiah, and they came up to Jerusalem. And they stood by the aqueduct of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
And they called to Hezekiah; and the king's steward, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder, went out to them.
And Rabshakeh said to them, "Say to Hezekiah, 'Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: What confidence is this in which you trust?'"
You speak of counsel and strength for the war; but whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?
እነሆ፥ በዚህ በተቀጠቀጠ በሸምበቆ በትር በግብፅ ትታመናለህ፤ ሰው ቢመረኰዘው ተሰብሮ በእጁ ይገባል፥ ያቈስለውማል፤ የግብፅ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ለሚታመኑበት ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።
እናንተም፦ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር እንታመናለን ብትሉኝ፥ ሕዝቅያስ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን፦ በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በዚህ መሠዊያ ፊት ስገዱ ብሎ የኮረብታ መስገጃዎቹንና መሠዊያዎቹን ያስፈረሰ ይህ አይደለምን?
አሁንም እንግዲህ ከጌታዬ ከአሦር ንጉሥ ጋር ተወራረድ፤ የሚቀመጡባቸውንም ሰዎች ማግኘት ቢቻልህ እኔ ሁለት ሺህ ፈረሶች እሰጥሃለሁ።
ስለ ሰረገሎችና ስለ ፈረሶች በግብፅ ስትታመን፥ ከጌታዬ አገልጋዮች የሚያንሰውን የአንዱን አለቃ ፊት ትመልስ ዘንድ እንዴት ይቻልሃል?
አሁን በውኑ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይህን ስፍራ እናጠፋ ዘንድ ወጥተናልን? እግዚአብሔር፦ ወደዚች ሀገር ወጥታችሁ አጥፉአት አለን።”
የኬልቅዩም ልጅ ኤልያቄም ሳምናስም ዮአስም ራፋስቂስን፥ “እኛ እንሰማለንና በሱርስት ቋንቋ ለአገልጋዮችህ ተናገር፤ በዕብራይስጥም ቋንቋ አትናገረን፤ በቅጥርም ላይ ያለው ሕዝብ በሚሰማው ቋንቋ ለምን ትናገራለህ?” አሉት።
ራፋስቂስ ግን፥ “በውኑ ጌታዬ ይህን ቃል እናገር ዘንድ ወደ እናንተና ወደ ጌታችሁ ልኮኛልን? ከእናንተ ጋር ኵሳቸውን ይበሉ ዘንድ ሽንታቸውንም ይጠጡ ዘንድ በቅጥር ላይ ወደ ተቀመጡት ሰዎች አይደለምን?” አላቸው።
ራፋስቂስም ቆሞ በታላቅ ድምፅ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ እንዲህ ብሎ ጮኸ፥ “የታላቁን የአሦር ንጉሥ ቃል ስሙ፤
ንጉሥ እንዲህ ይላል፦ ከእጄ ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አይችልምና ሕዝቅያስ አያታልላችሁ፤
ሕዝቅያስም፦ እግዚአብሔር በእርግጥ ያድነናል፤ ይህችንም ከተማ የአሦር ንጉሥ ሊይዛት አይችልም እያለ በእግዚአብሔር እንድትታመኑ አያድርጋችሁ።

"Do not listen to Hezekiah; thus says the king of Assyria: 'Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his own vine and each one from his own fig tree, and drink the water of your own cistern.'"

"This is to say, until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive oil and honey, that you may live and not die. And Hezekiah said: 'The Lord will surely deliver us.' Therefore do not listen to him."
"Indeed, has the god of the nations delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?"
"Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?"
"Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered their land from my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"
"But the people held their peace and answered him not a word; for the king's command was, 'Do not answer him.'"

"And the chief of the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah; and the scribe of the king, whose name was Shebna, and the historian, the son of Joah, came to Hezekiah and spoke to him the words of Rabshakeh."

sections.title: Hezekiah sought the counsel of Isaiah.

verses.text: And King Hezekiah, upon hearing this, tore his garments, and put on sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
And they said unto him, “Hezekiah thus saith: ‘This day is a day of trouble and of rebuke and of blasphemy; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.’”

“Perhaps the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard; therefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.”
Thus the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

And Isaiah said unto them, “Thus shall ye say to your master: ‘Thus saith the Lord: Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.’”
“Behold, I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumor, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”

sections.title: And it came to pass that Sennacherib did besiege Hezekiah.

verses.text: የአሦርም ንጉሥ ከለኪሶ እንደ ራቀ ሰምቶ ነበርና ራፋስቂስ ተመልሶ በሎምና ሲዋጋ አገኘው።
እርሱም፥ “የኢትዮጵያ ንጉሥ ቲርሐቅ ሊወጋህ መጥቶአል” የሚል ወሬ በሰማ ጊዜ ተመልሶ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ መልእክተኞችን ላከ፤ እንዲህ ሲል፦
“ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሕዝቅያስ እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት፦ ኢየሩሳሌም በአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ አትሰጥም ብሎ የምትታመንበት አምላክህ አያታልልህ።
እነሆ፥ የአሦር ነገሥታት በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ያደረጉትን፥ እንዴትስ እንዳጠፉአቸው ሰምተሃል፤ አንተስ ትድናለህን?
አባቶች ያጠፉአቸውን፥ ጎዛንን፥ ካራንን፥ ራፌስን በታኤሴቴም የነበሩትንም የዔድንን ልጆች፥ የአሕዛብ አማልክት አዳኑአቸውን?
የሐማት ንጉሥ፥ የአርፋድ ንጉሥ፥ የሴፋሩሄም ከተማ ንጉሥ፥ የኤናና የዓዋ ንጉሥ ወዴት አሉ?”
ሕዝቅያስም ደብዳቤውን ከመልእክተኞች እጅ ተቀብሎ አነበበው፤ ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው።
ሕዝቅያስም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ ጸለየ፥ “በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ የእስራኤል አምላክ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብቻህን የምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ አምላክ ነህ፤ ሰማይንና ምድርን ፈጥረሃል ።
አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን አዘንብልና ስማ፥ አቤቱ፥ ዐይንህን ክፈትና እይ፤ በሕያው አምላክ ላይ ይገዳደር ዘንድ የላከውን የሰናክሬምን ቃል ስማ።
አቤቱ፥ በእውነት የአሦር ነገሥት አሕዛብን አጥፍተዋል፤
They have cast their idols into the fire; for they were the work of human hands, of wood and stone, and not of the divine, therefore they have perished.
Now, O our God, let all the kingdoms of the earth know that You alone, O Lord, are God, and deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria.

sections.title: Isaiah sent to Hezekiah.

verses.text: The son of Amotz, Isaiah, sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib, king of Assyria.”
The daughter of Zion, you are like a forsaken woman, and the daughter of Jerusalem, the Lord has raised Himself up against you; this is the word that the Lord has spoken concerning him.
Who is it that you have been reproached, and against whom have you raised your voice? And against whom have you lifted your eyes on high? It is against the Holy One of Israel.

You have been reproached by your messengers, and you have blasphemed against the Lord; and you have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have gone up to the heights of the mountains, to the farthest parts of Lebanon; I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; I will enter its farthest height, its fruitful forest.”
I have made a desolation; I have drunk the water of the sea, and all the rivers I have dried up with the sole of my feet.
“Did you not hear what I did of old? Did you not hear how I have done it in former days? Now I have made it so that the fortified cities shall be for ruin, and they shall be for desolation.”

Therefore, the inhabitants of your cities are dismayed; they are struck with fear; they are like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like the grain blighted before it is grown.
But I know your dwelling place, and your going out and your coming in, and your rage against me.
Your rage and your arrogance have come up to my ears; therefore, I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way which you came.

“And this shall be a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, and in the second year what springs from that; but in the third year, sow and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.”
The house of Dan, the house of Judah, shall be brought low; and it shall be torn asunder above.
From Jerusalem shall come forth the cry, and from the mountain of Zion shall the voice of Dan be heard; for the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, shall perform this.

Is it not so? Concerning the king of Assyria, the Lord saith, “He shall not come into this city, nor shall he shoot an arrow therein; neither shall he come before it with a shield, nor cast up a siege mound against it.”
“He shall return by the way that he came, and shall not enter this city,” saith the Lord.
“And concerning me, concerning my servant David, I will defend this city.”

And that night the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
So Sennacherib, king of Assyria, arose, and went away, and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
And in the house of his god, they slew his sons with the sword; and they made their escape into the land of Ararat. And his son Esarhaddon reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The Death of King Hezekiah

verses.text: በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ ታመመ፤ ለሞትም ደረሰ። ነቢዩም የአሞጽ ልጅ ኢሳይያስ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ትሞታለህ እንጂ በሕይወት አትኖርምና ቤትህን አስተካክል” አለው።
ሕዝቅያስም ፊቱን ወደ ግድግዳው መልሶ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፦
“አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ በእውነትና በፍጹም ልብ እንደ ሄድሁ፥ መልካም ነገርም እንዳደረግሁ አስብ።” ሕዝቅያስም እጅግ አለቀሰ።
ኢሳይያስም ወደ መካከለኛው አደባባይ ሲደርስ እግዚአብሔር ተናገረው፤ እንዲህም አለው፦
“ተመልሰህ የሕዝቤን ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስን እንዲህ በለው፦ የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ እንባህንም አይቻለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ እኔ እፈውስሃለሁ፤ እስከ ሦስት ቀንም ድረስ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ትወጣለህ።
በዕድሜህም ላይ ዐሥራ አምስት ዓመት እጨምራለሁ፤ አንተንና ይህችን ከተማ ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ እታደጋለሁ፤ ስለ እኔ፥ ስለ ባሪያዬም ስለ ዳዊት ይህችን ከተማ አጋርዳታለሁ።”
ኢሳይያስም አለው፥ “የበለስ ጥፍጥፍ አምጥተህ በእባጭህ ላይ አድርግ ትፈወሳለህም።”
ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲፈውሰኝ፥ እኔስ እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንድወጣ ምልክቱ ምንድን ነው?” አለው።
ኢሳይያስም፥ “እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ነገር እንዲፈጽመው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምልክቱ ይህ ይሆንልሃል፤ ጥላው ዐሥር ደረጃ ወደ ፊት ይሂድን? ወይስ ዐሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላው ይመለስ?” አለ።
ሕዝቅያስም ኢሳይያስን፥ “ጥላው ዐሥር ደረጃ ቢጨምር ቀላል ነገር ነው፤ እንዲህ አይሁን፤ ነገር ግን ጥላው ዐሥር ደረጃ ወደ ኋላ ይመለሰ” አለው።
And the prophet Isaiah cried out unto the Lord; and his plea was turned back ten degrees.

sections.title: The messengers who came from Babylon.

verses.text: In those days, the king of Babylon, Merodach, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah, for he had heard that he had been sick and had recovered.

And Hezekiah was glad of them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures; there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah showed them not.

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto King Hezekiah, and said unto him, “What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee?” And Hezekiah said, “They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.”
And he said, “What have they seen in thy house?” And Hezekiah answered, “All that is in mine house have they seen; there is nothing among my treasures that I have not showed them.”
Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the Lord.
Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.”
And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”
Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, “Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. Moreover, for there shall be peace and truth in my days.”
And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

And Hezekiah slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchers of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honor at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The reign of Manasseh.

verses.text: ምናሴም በነገሠ ጊዜ ዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ሆኖት ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ኀምሳ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም ሐፍሴባ ነበረ።
እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳራቃቸው እንደ አሕዛብ ርኵሰት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገርን አደረገ።
አባቱም ሕዝቅያስ ያፈረሳቸውን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች መልሶ ሠራ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አክዓብ እንዳደረገው ለበዓል መሠዊያን ሠራ፤ የማምለኪያ ዐፀድንም ተከለ፤ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገደ አመለካቸውም።
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ስሜን በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራለሁ” ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መሠዊያን ሠራ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በሁለቱ ወለሎች ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ መሠዊያን ሠራ።
ልጁንም በእሳት ሠዋ፤ ሞራ ገላጭም ሆነ፤ አስማትም አደረገ፤ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም ሰበሰበ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እጅግ ክፉ ነገር አደረገ፤ ኣስቈጣውም።
እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊትና ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን፥ “በዚህ ቤት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጥኋት በኢየሩሳሌም ስሜን ለዘለዓለም አኖራለሁ፤
ያዘዝኋቸውንም ሁሉ ፥ ባሪያዬም ሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን ሕግ ሁሉ ቢያደርጉ ቢጠብቁም ለአባቶቻቸው ከሰጠኋት ምድር የእስራኤልን እግር እንደገና አላንቀሳቅስም” ባለው ቤት የሠራውን የማምለኪያ ዐፀድ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል አቆመ።
ነገር ግን አልሰሙም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ካጠፋቸው ከአሕዛብ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ዐይኖች ፊት ክፉ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ምናሴ አሳታቸው።
እግዚአብሔርም በባሪያዎቹ በነቢያት ቃል እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረ፦
"King Manasseh of Judah did more evil than all the Amorites who were before him, and he caused Judah to sin with his idols."
"Therefore, the God of Israel, the Lord, says this: Behold, I am bringing upon Jerusalem and Judah all the evil that they have done, and they will hear it with both ears."
